principles: Grill clarifies intent; evidence proves behavior.
Preserve the existing lifecycle state machine and evidence gates.
Prefer typed planning artifacts over prompt-only memory.
Keep first implementation small and reversible.
drivers: User wants more than a skill, but explicitly protects lifecycle and evidence management.
Koala gates consume structured facts, so new planning data needs a clear non-gate boundary.
PLAN review can surface unresolved grill work as advisory without changing DEV/REVIEW/TEST semantics.

options.name: A: Add grill as L1 planning artifact with CLI commands and story_review advisory
pros: Gives Koala durable structured grill sessions.
Does not pollute verificationEvidence or validation evidence.
cons: Requires small additions across CLI schema, store, types, registry, and review advisory.
Does not by itself enforce that every story runs a grill session.

options.name: B: Implement grill only as a local skill or prompt
pros: No registry or CLI contract updates needed.
cons: User explicitly said the solution should not be just a skill.
Prompt-only transcript is not recoverable or queryable through Koala CLI.

options.name: C: Make grill a hard PLAN gate before DEV
pros: Forces demand clarification on every high-risk story.
cons: Changes gate semantics and risks lifecycle friction.
Would require process-fact registry and stronger artifact signing before it is safe.
Conflicts with the user constraint to avoid damaging core lifecycle management.

chosen: A: Add grill as L1 planning artifact with CLI commands and story_review advisory
rationale: Option A satisfies the request for Koala-native implementation while keeping grill below behavior-proof evidence. It adds durable planning structure without adding a phase or DONE gate dependency.

preMortem.scenario: grill transcript is accidentally treated as verification evidence
preMortem.trigger: handler or docs describe grill as proof that behavior was tested
preMortem.consequence: DONE may pass based on planning text instead of real commands or validation
preMortem.mitigation: Use separate GrillSessionData, command policy status supported not gateEvidence, and docs wording that grill is planning context only.

preMortem.scenario: new commands drift from phase tool and command policy registries
preMortem.trigger: CLI tool is added without DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS or COMMAND_POLICIES updates
preMortem.consequence: flow stability or command lifecycle checks fail, or commands are unavailable in PLAN
preMortem.mitigation: Update cli-engine, config phase tools, command-policy, and focused smoke coverage together.

preMortem.scenario: PLAN review advisory becomes an unintended blocker
preMortem.trigger: story_review pushes unresolved grill issues with severity blocker
preMortem.consequence: grill silently becomes a new lifecycle gate
preMortem.mitigation: Implement grill review messages as advisory only and test that blockerCount stays zero for grill-only issues.

preMortem.scenario: artifact writes race with existing story metadata
preMortem.trigger: multiple grill_record calls overwrite the same file without reading latest state
preMortem.mitigation: Keep a single read-modify-write handler path and focused tests for append or update semantics.
